note: Newest first. One entry per change to a state's numbers or rules. Do not edit past entries.

entries.summary: Added Iowa from the 2026 Iowa Code: the fee for new registration ($10 plus 5% of the price less a trade-in, with credit for tax paid to another state), the $30 title fee, and registration at 1% of value plus 40 cents per 100 pounds. The value part for a new vehicle uses your price in place of the DOT's value and is marked check source; for a used vehicle it is not included.

Added Maryland: the 6.5% title excise tax after trade-in, registration by weight from July 2025 and the $40 yearly surcharge from the Maryland Code, and the $200 title fee and out-of-state credit rule from the MVA title and registration manual.

Added Colorado: the 2.9% state sales tax, trade-in rule, local tax by residence and out-of-state credit from the Department of Revenue, and from the DMV the title fee, first-year specific ownership tax (check source: it uses your price in place of the sticker price), road and bridge safety surcharges by weight, age of vehicle fee, fixed registration fees and electric vehicle fees. The registration base fee and later-year ownership tax are not included.

Added Kentucky: the 6% motor vehicle usage tax after trade-in and the out-of-state credit from the Department of Revenue, and the $9 title fee from state law. The $21 registration fee comes from a county clerk page and is marked check source.

Added Utah: the 4.85% state rate from the Tax Commission's October 2026 rate list, the trade-in rule and out-of-state credit from Publication 5, the $6 title fee, the 2026 uniform age-based fee, and the driver education and uninsured motorist fees from the DMV. The $44 registration fee is from Utah Code and marked check source because it is adjusted for inflation each year. The electric vehicle fee is not included.

Added Missouri: the 4.225% state sales tax after trade-in plus an entered local rate, the $8.50 title and $9 processing fees, and registration by taxable horsepower from the Department of Revenue. A new taxable horsepower field picks the registration fee. Credit for tax paid to another state is not applied until it is confirmed.

Added Louisiana: the 5% state sales tax rate, the trade-in rule, the $68.50 title fee, the $8 handling fee and the two-year license plate fee by value from the Department of Revenue and the Office of Motor Vehicles. Parish and city tax is entered by hand.

Added Oklahoma: the 3.25% excise tax and 1.25% vehicle sales tax (a trade-in lowers neither), the title, transfer, insurance and HB 1357 fees, and registration by year from Service Oklahoma. Credit for tax paid to another state is not applied until it is confirmed.
Added the LLC cost page: the $110 Articles of Organization fee and the $60 annual registration from the Secretary of State's fee schedule and filing guide.
Added the LLC cost page: the $150 filing fee and $75 annual report fee set in the Limited Liability Company Act.

Added the LLC cost page: the $99 filing fee from the Legislative Service Commission's list of Secretary of State fees. Whether any yearly filing applies could not be confirmed on a Secretary of State page, so the page is not yet public.
Added the LLC cost page: the $125 filing fee and $200 annual report fee from the Secretary of State's fee list, with the April 15 due date.
Added the LLC cost page: the $125 Certificate of Organization fee and the $7 annual report fee from the Department of State.
Added the LLC cost page: the $50 filing fee from the Corporation Commission's fee schedule. The Commission says LLCs file no annual report. Newspaper publication is listed as not included.
Added the LLC cost page: the $50 filing fee from the Articles of Organization form and the $25 annual statement fee from LARA.
Added the LLC cost page: the $180 Certificate of Formation fee and $70 annual report fee from the Secretary of State.
Added the LLC cost page: the $100 Certificate of Formation fee and $75 annual report fee from the Division of Revenue and Enterprise Services fee schedule.

Confirmed the $125 formation cost ($100 filing fee plus the required $25 registered agent fee) and the $138.75 yearly annual report fee on the Division of Corporations' fee page. The page is now published.

Added the LLC cost page: the Articles of Organization filing fee, the Statement of Information every two years and the annual LLC tax, each from the Secretary of State or Franchise Tax Board. The income-based LLC fee is not included.

Added the LLC cost page: the Certificate of Formation filing fee and the franchise tax report. The yearly tax is counted as zero for an LLC at or below the Comptroller's no-tax-due threshold and marked as needing a check. Franchise tax above the threshold is not included.

Added the LLC cost page with the Articles of Organization filing fee from state law. The yearly annual report fee could not be confirmed from the Division of Corporations' fee page, so the page is not yet public.

Added the LLC cost page: the Articles of Organization filing fee, the Certificate of Publication filing fee and the biennial statement fee, which is marked as needing a check. Newspaper publication costs and the Tax Department's LLC filing fee are not included.
Added the LLC cost page: the Certificate of Formation filing fee from the August 2026 fee schedule and the flat annual LLC tax due each June.

Added state with the 7% sales tax after trade-in, title, two-year registration by weight, the transportation surcharge, technology surcharge and the electric vehicle fee. The yearly city or town excise tax is not included.
The 6.5% state rate is now verified against the Department of Revenue's sales tax page.
Now applies credit for sales or use tax paid to another state, which state law allows against the use tax.

Added state with the 5% motor vehicle excise tax after trade-in (instead of a sales tax), title, disposal fee, yearly registration by weight and year first registered, and the electric vehicle road use fee.

Added state with the 6% sales tax after trade-in, credit for tax paid to another state, title, registration by vehicle age, the electric vehicle fee, the EMS fee and county administration fees for all 44 counties. The age band edges are marked partly verified.
Added state with the 4% excise tax after trade-in (instead of a sales tax), title, and yearly license fees by weight and vehicle age. Plate and mailing fees are not included.
Added state with no sales tax, title and the yearly registration fee by vehicle age (a new vehicle age input). The county option tax and luxury fee are not included.

Added state with the 5.5% sales tax (tax only on the difference when a vehicle is traded toward a vehicle), title and registration. The town's yearly excise tax is not included, and credit for tax paid elsewhere is not applied.
Added state with no state sales tax, an entered local rate, title and the two-year registration fee. The motor vehicle registration tax, which depends on location and model year, is not included.
Added state with the 5.25% document fee (Delaware has no sales tax) after trade-in, title, registration and the electric vehicle fee. The fee's rounding rules are not modeled.
Added state with the 5% sales tax after trade-in, no credit for tax paid elsewhere, title and first-time registration. Yearly county ad valorem and privilege taxes are not included.

Added state with the 6.85% state sales tax after trade-in, county rates from the Department of Taxation, title and registration. The yearly governmental services tax (based on original price) is not included.

Added state with the 6.5% state sales tax (new vehicles and used ones priced $10,000 or more), trade-in rule, an entered local rate, title, registration by weight and the electric vehicle fee. Lower state rates for used vehicles under $10,000 and the yearly county personal property tax are not included.

Added state with the 5% infrastructure maintenance fee (capped at $500, paid instead of sales tax), title, two-year registration and the electric vehicle fee. The county vehicle property tax and the hybrid fee are not included.

Added state with the 7% state sales tax after trade-in, the additional state tax on the second $1,600, the local tax on the first $1,600 (you enter the rate), title, county clerk title fee, registration and the electric vehicle fee. County wheel taxes and clerk registration fees are not included.

Added state with the 6.5% state sales tax after trade-in, an entered local rate, title, registration by weight, the county service fee and the electric vehicle fee. The yearly county property tax and hybrid fees are not included.

Added state with the 5.5% sales tax, an entered local rate, title, registration, plate and other registration fees and the electric vehicle fee. The yearly motor vehicle tax and fee, city wheel taxes and the plug-in hybrid fee are not included.

Added state with the 6% purchase and use tax after trade-in, title, registration by fuel type and the new-vehicle warranty fee. The electric vehicle infrastructure fee amount, the lien fee and credit for tax paid elsewhere are not included.

Added state with the 6% titling tax on the price after trade-in, title fee, registration and the electric vehicle fee. Credit for tax paid to another state is not confirmed, and the lien and hybrid fees are not included.

Added state with the 6.35% sales tax, the higher rate on vehicles priced above $50,000, trade-in credit for dealer purchases, title, registration and DMV fees. The yearly town property tax is not included.
Added state with the 2% state sales tax, title, registration and the electric vehicle fee. Local city and county tax is entered by you because the state guide lists no rates.

Added city privilege tax for 96 cities and towns, including the lower rate many charge on the part of a single item above a set price. Rates come from the October 2026 state table; the wording for some price tiers is not fully explicit, so the local rate stays marked partly verified.
Added state with the 5% sales tax, county rates for all 72 counties and the City of Milwaukee, title, registration and the electric vehicle surcharge. The wheel tax is not included.
Added state with the 7% sales tax, title, registration and the electric vehicle supplemental fee. The yearly excise tax and county wheel tax are not included.
Added state with the 6.25% sales tax, title fee and two-year registration. The yearly excise tax billed by your city or town is not included.
Added state with the 6.625% sales tax, title fee, registration by weight and model-year age, the 0.4% luxury surcharge and the zero emission vehicle fee. Added a New or used choice to the calculator.
Added state with the 5.6% state rate, county rates from the October 2026 table, title and registration fees. The vehicle license tax and city tax are not included.

Added state with the 7% combined state rate, local rates for 403 locations from the October 2026 table, and title and registration fees. Electric vehicle fees and the regional transit excise tax are not included.
Added state with the 4.15% sales and use tax, title fee and registration by weight class. The highway use fee is not included.
Added the county vehicle use tax and the $50 commuter district fee for New York City and seven counties. They follow the county you choose and the vehicle weight.
Title fee now follows your county ($33 in 42 counties, $28 elsewhere). Added the $1 insurance verification and $4.75 processing fees to the total.
Added state with county registration fees.
Added state; county and city sales tax rates added.
Added state; county discretionary surtax rates added.
Added state; county and city sales tax rates added.
Added state.
Added state; Allegheny and Philadelphia local tax available.
Added state; county sales tax rates for the fourth quarter of 2026 added.
Added state (title ad valorem tax).
Added state (highway use tax).
